source.summary: Seven final sparks sweep from left to right across the name with staggered lower-left launches, varied speed, diagonal undulation and light upward arcs that lose altitude at different times.

visual_role: A brief crystal accent that carries the lockup from reveal into hold. It should imply wind through unequal launch timing and trajectories while keeping SGDK/FORGE readable.

trajectory_model.x_formula: x0 + trunc_toward_zero(vx_q8 * t / 256) + trunc_toward_zero(wind_x_q8 * t * t / 512)
trajectory_model.y_formula: y0 + trunc_toward_zero(vy_q8 * t / 256) + trunc_toward_zero(gravity_y_q8 * t * t / 512) + trunc_toward_zero(wave_amplitude_px * sin16[((t + wave_phase) >> 1) & 15] / 256)
trajectory_model.runtime_policy: Integer-only fixed trajectories; no heap, floating point, random state, H-Int, per-frame tile upload or sprite multiplexing. Hide each spark outside its authored lifetime.

budget_contract.headroom_justification: The seven-particle accent is intentionally sparse and brief so the SGDK mark remains dominant; its path overlap will be measured for every sweep frame.
budget_contract.measurement_required: All 30 scene frames with actual 8x8 positions; report peak count, width and frame/line.

fallback.trigger: The new paths obscure the wordmark, bunch into a single streak, exceed H40 limits, or produce visible stepping.
fallback.action: Restore the prior straight sweep from the same particle strip and keep the motion contract as a rejected WIP experiment.

visual_review_note: The user rejected this ROM as monotonous and lacking the agreed animation and energy. Keep this contract and its measurements as a historical failure record, not as an accepted art-direction result.
